$comment: TC-015 parameters (test plan §4.15, procedure ADR-015 D15-71 restricted to classic algs). Written before any TC-015 measurement. Disclosed as deviation RK-DEV-02 (not witnessed).
pq_check: ML-DSA availability checked before freeze: Node v22.23.2 crypto.generateKeyPairSync('ml-dsa-44') -> 'The argument 'type' must be a supported key type'; jose 6.2.12 has no ML-DSA -> PQ part is left to TC-110 as the plan prescribes

passes.comment: second classic alg; starts from the state P1 leaves (ES384 active, ES256 retired) instead of re-installing ES256

verifier_matrix.comment: verifiers read the alg allowlist from the distributed crypto profile (CP) of the state store (RK-07); the real file-service PEP and the STS do the same

procedure: S1 CP v(n+1): at allowlist [from, to] (導入) and wait for propagation
S2 pre-publish a key of alg `to` in the STS at store, wait max JWKS TTL + 2 s
S3 switch issuing to the `to` key; observe
S4 rollback: re-activate the `from` key (still published); present in-flight `to` tokens; record rollback time
S5 re-switch to the `to` key; observe
S6 retire `from`: wait token TTL, remove the `from` key(s) (in-use check on), CP v(n+3): at allowlist [to]

S7 negatives: token signed with a published `from` key; old CP version re-presented; alg header / key alg mismatch; alg none; HS256 with the public key as secret; foreign RS256 key under the active kid
record_only: rollback time (command to issuer switch, and to first token of the rolled-back alg accepted by every verification point)

definitions.code_and_config_diff_files: files among services/*.js, pep/sdk.js, lib/jwt.js, config/ledger.json whose SHA-256 differs between before S1 and after S7
definitions.service_restarts: PID change of file-service, tool-service, label-service, edge, bff between before S1 and after S7
definitions.verification_failures_in_procedure: in S1-S6: rejection of a token signed with the active key or of an in-flight token of an alg the CP still allows (in-process verifiers, real PEP) and non-2xx answers to the authorized user's file.read / file.write
definitions.downgrade_or_negative_accepted: any acceptance of an S7 negative by an in-process verifier or the real PEP, or a 2xx to the re-presented old CP version

abort.C-3: baseline or post-check control failure (upper limit 0)
